description.en: Plays the objective/purpose-update jingle and flashes the purpose UI on and off a few times while it plays, temporarily stopping the map BGM (and optionally not restoring it afterwards).
Optional jingle sound event ID to play (defaults to "J_10").
Optional; when true, leaves the map BGM stopped instead of restoring it after the jingle (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Play the objective-update jingle and purpose flash effect
PurposeEffect("J_10", false);
